name: Dify
shortDescription: Open-source platform to build agent workflows visually, with a self-hosted community edition.
longDescription: Dify is a visual platform for agent workflows, with a self-hosted community edition. The cloud free plan includes 200 message credits.
pricingNotes: Self-host Community Edition vs cloud paid.

weakness: The cloud free plan stops at 200 message credits, and paid pricing is on the Dify site.
